description: Remove items from the incoming list that duplicate an earlier item, comparing all fields or a chosen subset.

compare.description: Which fields to use when deciding whether two items are duplicates.

fieldsToCompare.description: Field paths (dot notation) used when compare is not "allFields": the fields to exclude for "allFieldsExceptSelected", or the only fields compared for "selectedFields".

disableDotNotation.description: Treat field paths as literal keys instead of dot-notation nested paths.
